name: Bybit Spot BTCUSDT public trades
description: Normalized Bybit v5 `publicTrade.BTCUSDT` fills. One message carries up to 1024 individual fills, each with its own event_time, price, size and taker direction; aggressor_side is the provider taker side and is emitted directly. trade_id is the opaque provider fill id: its contiguity is not documented, so no gap or continuity logic reads it. cross_sequence is a relative-ordering token with no documented gap semantics — a message whose minimum cross_sequence falls below the running maximum raises an out-of-order notice, and its trades are still emitted, because valid data is never discarded. Equal cross_sequence values are legal: one match event fans out to several fills that share a sequence. block_trade and rpi preserve the venue's block-trade and retail-price-improvement flags; an absent rpi is recorded as false. Every entry is validated (symbol, side, decimals, event time) before any ordering check, so a malformed fill fails closed regardless of its sequence. Rights-gated: the Bybit row in knowledge/RIGHTS-LEDGER.md is unverified and the lane refuses to start unless SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES lists bybit. expected_heartbeat_ms is 60000, a silence bound the feed-health board applies to event arrival, not a cadence (E31): the tape is event-driven and can be quiet, so socket liveness is carried by the ping/pong Heartbeat notice.
